description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git commands outside of a repository context. It sets up various test cases to verify Git features and behaviors when running in directories that are not part of a Git repository. The script uses functions and utilities like 'test_expect_success', 'test_must_fail', and others, which are likely defined in the sourced 'test-lib.sh' file, to automate and verify different scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed; it runs a command sequence and checks for successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that is expected to fail and verifies that it does fail.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Outputs given lines to a file, used to set up test data.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or inputs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global Git configuration options for testing.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks the output of 'git grep' commands against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Runs a command expecting a specific exit code.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
